teamColumns.title: Investigators
teamColumns.text: Yan's Lily Chen deck, Shengbo's George Barnaby deck, and LL's Trish Scarborough deck are recorded for the Innsmouth run.

notes.title: Table Setup
items: Investigators: Lily Chen, George Barnaby, Trish Scarborough

notes.title: Opening Notes
items: Lily Chen's opening deck includes In the Thick of It, so she starts the campaign with 3 XP and chooses to take 2 total trauma as 1 physical trauma and 1 mental trauma.

storyNotes.title: Scenario I: The Pit of Despair

notes.title: The Investigators Entered the Pit
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough woke in a cold, wet cavern with no memory of the recent past and only fragments of identity intact.
The chamber felt recently underwater, the ceiling held a strange slab of alien metal, and a croaking, gurgling sound echoed through the tunnels as the investigators searched for a way out.
The scenario introduced flashbacks and colored keys; the recovered flashbacks became the first pieces of the larger Innsmouth mystery.

notes.title: Flashbacks
items: Flashback I: record a meeting with Thomas Dawson under Memories Recovered.
Flashback II: record a battle with a horrifying devil under Memories Recovered, and remove 1 cultist token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback III: record a decision to stick together under Memories Recovered, and remove 1 tablet token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
Flashback IV: record an encounter with a secret cult under Memories Recovered, and remove 1 elder thing token from the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

notes.title: Resolution 1
items: George Barnaby, Lily Chen, and Trish Scarborough resigned.
The investigators escaped the pit alive after hearing a stranger call out and finding Agent Harper, but their missing memories and the crimson sky made it clear that the conspiracy had only begun.
Victory display: 2. Each investigator records 2 unspent XP, but none of this experience is spent yet.
Proceed to Interlude I: Puzzle Pieces.

notes.title: Interlude I: Puzzle Pieces
items: Agent Harper questioned the investigators about the memories they recovered, helped establish that the date was September 24, and pressed them for anything else they could remember.
Because a meeting with Thomas Dawson was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because a battle with a horrifying devil was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because a decision to stick together was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Because an encounter with a secret cult was recovered, the conspiracy deepens and each investigator records 1 additional unspent XP.
Total unspent XP from Scenario I plus Interlude I: 6 XP for each investigator.
Proceed to Scenario II: The Vanishing of Elina Harper.
